text: Your analysis is going to give you a wrong answer someday and the worst part, it won't crash.
It won't throw an error. Python will just sit there and hand you a number.
So plausible that you will believe it. Here is how this happens. Your CSV comes in
with a column called H. You load it. You sum the values. Python reports a total and you move on.
Except that column was stored as text or string. Not numbers. So when Python added them,
it did not calculate, for example, 28 plus 35 plus 42. Rather, it smashed the strings together,
